description:
Crew Apollo is a three-member team from Mymensingh, Bangladesh, passionate about space, data, AI/ML and problem-solving. 
MD. Morsadul Islam (Team lead, developer), 
Alif Mahmud (lead developer, 3D design) and 
Snigdha Rani Das (ML engineer, research) 
combine software, AI/ML, data analysis, 3D design and communication. We built AstroDocX on a tested, explainable engine and open NASA data, and share our code under the MIT license.
